raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: ml-collections
  version: 1.0.0
  python_min: 3.10

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/ml_collections-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 00b11a1a339dd6c2d9b7f0daab47ab17e10e29ca1b2a656058605e2b7210897f

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - flit-core
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - absl-py
    - pyyaml
    - six

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - ml_collections
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: ML Collections is a library of Python collections designed for ML usecases.
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/google/ml_collections

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hadim
